Synopsis:
Gyldro Angleiron the Smith, a crusty human male, runs his smithy in the center of Rivington called Angleiron Smithy.He usually greets potential customers in front of his smithy. But today, Orin the Red, perverse and malicious, has assumed his likeness and identity to greet the unsuspecting players.This is her way of learning about the players in person, to tailor-made a death just for them.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_OrinsImpersonation_SmithOrin.json: Gyldro Angleiron is a well‑known smith who normally stands outside his shop to greet customers, but in this scene the voice and manner belong to Orin the Red—she’s using Gyldro’s likeness to size up the party. Off‑screen Orin has already proven adept at impersonation and infiltration (including taunting Gortash and abducting people elsewhere), so her friendly questions about weapons and how the party likes to kill are probes to learn personal weaknesses and tastes she can exploit. The city is tense from recent brainquake events and scheming around Netherstones, and Orin’s interest in whether the party would harm their own allies ties into her broader role as a tormentor/Bhaal agent who tailors threats or ultimatums. Players should read these lines as an ambush of conversation—Orin is gathering information under the smith’s guise and may later drop the disguise or use what she learns against them.
- WYR_OrinsImpersonation_Smith.json: Gyldro Angleiron the Smith unknowingstly was knocked unconcious by Orin the Red.  He only awakes once Orin the Red has teleported away - leaving the players with the awkward circumstance of being at his smithy.  He views the players with suspicion until convinced either-wise.
- WYR_Rivington_ArmoryShopkeeper.json: Dialog for the shopkeeper of the armory store in the Rivington, next to the smithy. Reactivity if the smith is missing/player killed him.
- DEN_Weaponsmith_PostEA.json: Players can approach a tiefling blacksmith. He used to have a proper forge in Elturel, but is now trying to make do in the grove. The gear he has available is usable, but not great.
- WYR_Wulbren.json: Main Wulbren dialog in gnomes hideout cellar of a smithy in Rivington. Wulbren should give player a quest to destroy Gondian workshop.

context: Gyldro Angleiron is the well‑known human smith who normally stands outside Angleiron Smithy to greet customers, but in this scene the voice and manner belong to Orin the Red—who has already knocked Gyldro unconscious off‑screen and taken his likeness. Orin is an expert at impersonation and infiltration, and she’s casually questioning the party about weapons and how they like to kill as a way to learn personal weaknesses she can exploit. Her questions—especially whether the party could turn on their friends—are probes for tailored threats or ultimatums tied to the city’s tense political climate (brainquake events and Netherstone scheming). The players are unaware this is an ambush; Gyldro may later awaken and react with suspicion once Orin has left or been revealed.
